original_source: IID native even-level qutrit phases with two uniform full-ring frequency vectors, shared modular secret and charged fresh samples.
constructive_primitive: Fixed onehot embedding and explicit quadratic-size two-register root QFT recipe produce paired noisy modular linear equations; all outcomes are retained.
exact_noise_support: Characteristic support Delta={0,+/-(1,0),+/-(0,1),+/-(1,-1)}; coefficients1 or1/3; pairs independent across fresh qutrits but not within each pair.
implemented_components: Exact scalar linear-attack signal classification and joint rectangular compression characteristic
Invertible uniform-marginal countercontrol preserving joint information
Classical Gaussian collimation with exact residue phase tags and independent ancestor tracking
Costed exact BKW collision and original-record bias ledgers
Native IID held-out candidate verifier without all-secret enumeration
Polynomial-sample unique score separation theorem with explicitly exponential reference search
Actual polynomial radix decoder that explicitly requires chosen native frequencies
negative_evidence: Every proper quotient of the paired noise is uniform; field-shadow Hensel starting equations are invalid.
Generic scalar modular elimination is exactly uniform unless all nonzero weight pairs share a unit-scaled root direction.
Measured Gaussian collimation multiplies first-character amplitudes; it is not pure quantum phase-state sieving.
The live27-input classical collimation branch has bias1/6561 and zero final frequency, hence no secret signal.
Rejection-compiling the implemented exact radix schedule from native random labels costs q^n expected input samples per selected label.

proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-REVIEW: Independent mathematical review of the paired channel, scalar classification, tagged collimation and estimator probability arguments.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-CIRCUIT: Charge hardware embedding, controlled-root precision and aggregate readout error; bounded replay is not a full hardware compiler.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SEARCH: Generate a polynomial shortlist from native random-label records, or supply a polynomial coherent/source-valid compiler for informative frequencies.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SOURCE: Keep the actual correlated paired noise, all outcome tags, full modulus and fresh ancestor independence. No Gaussian, binary-error or field-shadow substitution.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-COST: Charge exact/approximate label acquisition, quantum copies, collisions, failures, repetitions and all sampled ancestors.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-VALIDATION: Candidate proposals must be independent of held-out labels and outcomes; adaptive reuse is not covered by the verifier bound.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-BASELINES: Compare joint raw-sample classical inference and known complete sieves. Uniform scalar marginals are not a general dequantization/no-go result.

falsifiers: Explicit native gate replay disagrees with original-ring Born probabilities.
Paired errors are treated as independent or three derived equations as three fresh samples.
Proper-quotient outcomes falsely constrain a secret digit.
A scalar no-go is extrapolated to the invertible joint countercontrol.
Collimation omits phase tags, repeats ancestors or retains unit visibility after noisy convolution.
A decoder uses chosen labels, planted truth, exhaustive ML, or training data as an uncharged held-out certificate.
